name: RoleControl
short: Owner-only self-service role assignment and removal for FATBOY.
description: Provides roleme/giverole, unroleme/removemyrole and myroles. Only Red bot owners can run these commands; respects Discord's Manage Roles permission and role hierarchy.
author: Will
North
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store or collect personal data. It only changes the invoking bot owner's roles within the server at their request; Discord retains its own audit logs.
